raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. (tree) , (pokok) laurel; 2. (in pl) wreath of laurel leaves, lingkar(an) daun laurel: the Roman hero was crowned with ~s, pahlawan Rom itu dimahkotai dgn lingkaran daun laurel; 3. (in pl), (fig.) honour, penghargaan: he took all the credit but the ~s really belong to his staff, dia membolot segala pujian tetapi penghargaan itu sebenarnya milik kakitangannya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
